name: tesota
description: An open-source, verification-first agent for work that carries its evidence

scripts.test: bun run build && bun run test:run
scripts.test:run: vitest run tests --exclude tests/candidate-checkout.test.ts --exclude tests/candidate-task.test.ts --maxWorkers=1 --no-file-parallelism --testTimeout=10000 && vitest run tests/candidate-checkout.test.ts --maxWorkers=1 --no-file-parallelism --testTimeout=10000 && vitest run tests/candidate-task.test.ts --maxWorkers=1 --no-file-parallelism --testTimeout=10000
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run lint
